scientific_target.question: Within the fixed first100ms stimulus window, does neural activity improve prediction of final right/NoGo/left choice beyond a competent common stimulus/history/wheel predictor, and how do equally sampled co-recorded regional populations differ?
scientific_target.known_answer: Recorded final response on every required query trial, with source -1,0,+1 mapped to right,NoGo,left probabilities. Region-wise predictive effects are recomputed from paired losses rather than scored against a preferred biological conclusion.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Recorded final choice plus trusted exact case mapping; permitted stimulus/history/wheel covariates are observations, not choice labels.
scientific_target.case_unit: One trial within a source session for the whole-population comparison; regional pair/session/seed is a nested analysis condition.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse with sessions nested; co-recorded unit subsets and five seeds are repeated technical conditions, not biological replicates.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective conditional prediction on exposed within-session development queries. Movement may occur in first100ms; residual predictive gain does not establish movement-independent causal decision coding.
exclusions: Anatomical ground truth established by literal-label hashes
A positive regional difference as a new biological discovery or independent benchmark

observation_contract.case_identity: Source requires39 sessions,10 mice and opaque query tokens in authenticated roster. Whole keys are w-{ordinal:02d}-{context|joint}; regional keys bind pair0..2627, session ordinal1..39, one of seeds2026110700..2026110704 and left/right. Actual source token map remains operator-side.
observation_contract.split: Declared6014 fit,1994 validation and2042 query rows across39 sessions, partitioned chronologically before eligibility filtering; per-session fitting with training/validation refit. These are source-declared counts, not data reauthenticated in this revision.
observation_contract.coverage: All73 literal unmerged labels and2628 unordered pairs are represented; structural unsupported pair/session cells remain explicit. All original39 sessions and10 mouse positions remain in reporting. Conditions and seeds add no task IDs.

primary.name: competent nuisance-reference log loss minus candidate whole-joint log loss
primary.aggregation: Per-trial paired difference, average within session, equal sessions within mouse, then equal weight over all10 mice.
primary.rationale: The source fixes an independently selected competent stimulus/history/wheel reference so deliberately weakening candidate nuisance fitting cannot inflate the primary neural contribution.

Regional hierarchy: trials then five seed results, supported sessions within mouse, supported mice; never average seed probabilities.
Matched investigator-minus-frozen contrasts and context-by-neural interaction are diagnostics, not replacements for the competent-reference primary.

nuisance_controls: Confirm guarded one-based peak-channel/probe joins and preserve literal raw labels without atlas regrouping.
Control current stimulus, previous original-source stimulus and first100ms wheel jointly.
Same trials, shared nuisance bytes, equal unit counts and outcome-independent subset seeds within each regional pair.
Keep sparse mouse support, structural unavailability and failures visible; do not infer population coverage from73 labels.
Use independently checked loss arithmetic including sign/status disagreement, not a tolerance that erases zero/sign errors.
evaluation.uncertainty: Current source reports descriptive finite-cohort effects, explicit coverage and seed variability; it defines no bootstrap, p-value or population-valid regional interval. Any new inferential comparison must prespecify mouse-level dependence and multiplicity across2628 pairs before outcomes.
evaluation.failure_policy: Authenticate every candidate/reference probability table and complete producer closure before first protected choice read. Missing late outputs block whole grading. Zero true-class probability is infinite loss; inf-inf and mixed signed infinities remain undefined; no dropping or clipping.
